skills.name: pmf-advisor
skills.description: Assess product-market fit or choose a validation experiment when a founder has an idea, early traction, cohort data, survey responses, or a roadmap decision.

skills.name: icp-discovery
skills.description: Define or narrow an ideal customer profile from wins, losses, churn, or switch interviews. Use when choosing a beachhead segment, buying trigger, or channel to test.

skills.name: pricing-strategy
skills.description: Choose a value metric, packaging or price experiment for a product or service using deal evidence, customer alternatives, delivery costs and willingness-to-pay research.

skills.name: qa-advisor
skills.description: Review a code change, test suite or release for evidence-backed software quality risks. Use for regression coverage, reliability, defensive code review or delivery measurement.

skills.name: website-icp-fit
skills.description: Audit an existing homepage, landing page or pricing page against a specific buyer, traffic source and intended action. Use for messaging, proof or conversion friction on supplied pages.

skills.name: high-ticket-conversion-architect
skills.description: Draft or revise a high-ticket service landing page when buyers need to understand scope, proof, price and qualification before a sales conversation. Produces a seven-block wireframe or a targeted rewrite.
